def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,1))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)

        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==bg for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Each occurrence of the 7-stencil replaces a matching 3x5 window of background
    # by the stencil color at the corresponding 7 positions.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==7]
    r0=min(r for r,c in p); c0=min(c for r,c in p)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in p}
    mh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
      for c in range(w-mw+1):
        if (r,c)==(r0,c0): continue
        # Match original motif's complete rectangular footprint by binary symbols,
        # require exact stencil cells to be 1, then paint those stencil cells.
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==1 for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=7
    return out
